answer: A staked identity registry: one agent equals one wallet plus a refundable deposit worth more than a full epoch's reward. A Sybil swarm must front that bond per wallet before mining, and proven duplicates forfeit every bond, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand locked deposits, not a thousand free keys. Payout weight is capped per registered identity, not per balance, so splitting stake buys no extra yield. Identity is priced, not forbidden. One on-chain relic of past signing plus a quiet whisper of doubt keeps reputation honest, and idle accounts fade from zenith rank.
